verticillium-albo-atrum.source: U.S. Register of Introduced and Invasive Species
verticillium-albo-atrum.note: Older references used this name for several fungi. EPPO now identifies the Oregon hop outbreaks as V. nonalfalfae. A DNA study also identified 13 cultures filed under the older name as V. nonalfalfae. Our registry entry gives too little detail to tell which modern species it represents. For a separate culture, DSM 12231, the genome paper uses V. albo-atrum and its sample record lists cotton from Qinghai, China, in 2024. DSMZ lists V. longisporum from Africa before 1998. We cannot yet tell which material was sequenced. This catalog entry has no attached county occurrences.
